"To anyone who thinks they can exploit a child and escape accountability because they're operating online: you are wrong," a district attorney stated. "The digital footprints you leave are permanent. That single report allowed investigators to identify a pattern connecting several potential victims across state lines, prompting the formation of the joint task force.
